notes:
Trim from a point, and a straight answer about interlaced footage.

'trim the footage from 5s' used to answer 'I didn't catch an edit in that', while 'start at 5s' — the same request — worked fine. It now trims from where you say.

And asking Crisp to deinterlace no longer pretends not to understand you. Crisp doesn't deinterlace; it now says so, and points you at HandBrake's Decomb filter or ffmpeg's yadif, because combing has to come off before an upscaler sees it or it gets sharpened in permanently.
